title: How Notion handles concurrent editing with CRDTs
summary: Stops last-write-wins from losing concurrent block edits with an RGA text CRDT that tracks text across block splits.

title: Rebuilding Notion's lexical search reindexer
summary: Replaces a slow, gap-prone reindexer on the live Elasticsearch API with Spark jobs that write restorable snapshots.

title: Balancing cost and reliability for Spark on Kubernetes
summary: Stops a spot interruption from killing many of a Spark job's executors at once with Spot Balancer's per-job spot cap.

title: How we made Notion available offline
summary: Prevents pages kept offline for several reasons from losing access when one is cleared by storing a row per reason.

title: How we sped up Notion in the browser with WASM SQLite
summary: Ends SQLite corruption from concurrent OPFS writers by routing all tabs' queries via a SharedWorker to one active tab.

title: Building and scaling Notion's data lake
summary: Replaces Snowflake ingestion, slow and costly for update-heavy blocks, with Debezium CDC via Kafka into Hudi on S3.

title: The Great Re-shard: adding Postgres capacity (again) with zero downtime
summary: Relieves Postgres shards near CPU and IOPS limits by moving logical schemas to more hosts behind a sharded PgBouncer.

title: Herding elephants: Lessons learned from sharding Postgres at Notion
summary: Heads off TXID wraparound as VACUUM stalled by sharding the Postgres monolith by workspace ID into logical schemas.
